item.title: Crimson Masterbuilt Xplorer
item.description:
Crimson Masterbuilt Xplorer
Built by Matt and wired by Sam in the Crimson Custom Shop!
Specs:
Mahogany Body and Neck
Flamed Maple top and Headstock cap
Brown/Amber fade
Wenge fretboard
Maple/Black MOP dragon inlay
Black MOP side dots
Gotoh TOM bridge and tail piece
Gotoh Locking tuners
@bareknucklepickupsofficial Holydiver battle worn set
@graphtechguitarlabs Black TUSQ nut
2x Volume and master tone with coil split push pull
Full polyurethane high gloss finish

item.title: I’ve convinced myself that fretwork is fun.
item.description:
I’ve convinced myself that fretwork is fun.

I did hate it… but now I find it therapeutic.

Thank you @crimsonguitars for making some sweet tools with ergonomic handles, and thank you @walrusoil for making the finish that I’ve trusted for years!
